narration.text: [whispers] Watch the chair. Not the bed. The chair. [long pause] [softly] Enfield, north London. August, nineteen seventy-seven. A council house. A mother, and four children. [long pause] It started with knocking. Inside the walls. [long pause] A police officer came, at about one in the morning. She said she watched a chair slide across the floor. By itself. [long pause] Investigators taped this house for over a year. On the tapes, knocks seem to answer questions. [long pause] And there is a voice. A deep, old man's voice. It came from one of the girls. [long pause] Skeptics said the children faked it. Years later, one of the girls said they had faked a little. Once or twice. [long pause] [whispers] You were watching the chair. Weren't you?
